Tens of Thousands Rally in Belgrade Ahead of Serbian Elections

Tens of thousands of people joined a student-led rally in Belgrade, Serbia, on Sunday, ahead of pivotal elections. The "Student List" movement is aiming to unseat the party of veteran leader Aleksandar Vučić. Reports indicate the crowd size reached approximately 150,000.
